content:
Apple will hold its annual iPhone launch event this week, which will also see the introduction of new Apple Watch models. Here's a preview of the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12.

The Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Apple Watch Series 12 will feature upgrades including a new chip and health features

If you're interested in the new iPhone models being unveiled this week, there are already plenty of leaks summarising the expected specs for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone Ultra.

However, there's been far less coverage of the new Apple Watch models launching at the same event.

The event is expected to introduce two new Watch models:

  • Apple Watch Ultra 4
  • Apple Watch Series 12

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman has previously reported that both new models will feature 'a long-awaited chip and speed boost'.

Current Watch models use the S10 chip, but overall performance hasn't changed much since the S9 in 2023. With watchOS 27 bringing Siri AI, a more powerful S11 chip couldn't be more timely.

Digitimes claims the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will have a 'major redesign', but Gurman believes a major design overhaul won't arrive until at least next year. However, he also mentioned that Apple will reintroduce a ceramic case option with this year's models.

The same Digitimes report also claims the Apple Watch Ultra 4 will feature a 'significant upgrade in sensing capabilities', with as many as double the number of sensors.

Some of the new sensors may be related to the rumoured upgrade for high blood pressure notifications.

Apple introduced high blood pressure notifications with watchOS 26 last year. Reports indicate the FDA is reviewing a new notification feature related to high blood pressure, expected to debut alongside the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12.

Bloomberg also reports Apple may include a new always-on heart rate sensor in its latest Watch models.

Summary of the new Apple Watch models

Overall, Apple's new Watch models still have plenty of room to surprise us. A new chip, minor design updates and health features all seem quite likely, but we'll have to wait until Wednesday for more details.

What new features do you most want to see in the Apple Watch Ultra 4 and Series 12? Let us know in the comments.
